listing.name: Kameo RePowered
listing.summary: Explore Kameo RePowered and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep a lawful completed native copy
steps.instruction: Use an already lawfully prepared working Windows x64 kameorepowered.exe copy with its complete adjacent dependencies and the original creating data/profile. Published releases or old matching digests do not override that exclusion. steps.instruction: Use your own Kameo: Elements of Power Xbox 360 original, upstream documented USA extracted assets/default.xex, and complete existing extracted data. steps.title: Select the game with its established roots
steps.instruction: Select kameorepowered.exe itself, with the actual writable installation-root initial CWD. For the tagged pinned-SDK interface, review --game_data_root and the absolute existing assets directory as two literal arguments. Preserve the creating --update_data_root and its absolute extracted update path when that TU copy requires it, plus any established --user_data_root and --cache_root choices, each followed by its separate absolute path token. Keep spaces inside each path token. Do not choose scripts/run.py, an extractor, Goopie or a build/helper entry. Registration itself does not prepare or launch anything; retain an already working build-specific launch context rather than inventing a profile.

steps.title: Review intent and keep replacement upstream-owned
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact native executable, actual initial working directory and literal arguments; choose Play separately. Core observes the selected process, not an exclusive family or sandbox. Upstream/player owns original extraction, setup, repair and actual replacement. Close all real instances before changing files, retain the old creating copy and review a changed executable through relink. Removing registration removes only metadata and preserves external bytes.

steps.title: Preserve the actual runtime, originals and user profile
steps.instruction: Keep the complete runtime/original/asset/update/DLC roots and kameorepowered.toml, all actual user/save/content/cache/log/mod/custom paths and unknown files. The reviewed SDK uses the Windows known Documents folder plus kameorepowered by default (Documents may be redirected), including Xbox-style 0000000000000000/4D5307D2/00000002 DLC content; explicit root choices override defaults. Preserve any custom roots separately. Keep variant-specific state with its creating copy; do not move or regenerate state merely to register.
